published_statement: Restated (2106.03960v2 p.1, verbatim): 'some black hole phenomena can also be investigated in the context of analogue gravity [6, 7]. For instance, recent experiments with water, with quantum fluids of light, and with Bose-Einstein condensates have allowed the observation of Hawking radiation [8-13] and of rotational superradiance [14] in earth-based laboratories.' Same paper p.1: 'the occurrence of Hawking radiation and of superradiance are independent of Omega [19, 20]. In fact, the temperature of the Hawking radiation is a conformal invariant, but the greybody factors are not.' Analogue metric (p.7, eq. B1): ds^2 = (rho^2/c^2)[-(c^2 - v^2)dt^2 - 2v dt dx + dx^2 + dy^2]. On the 'same family' (negative-energy) link for the GRAVITATIONAL process: 2102.13551 p.5: 'to make the existence of Hawking radiation compatible with the black hole area increase theorem, one must violate the null energy condition (NEC) through quantum effects'; 'explicit test-field numerical calculations of the renormalized stress-energy tensor in Schwarzschild and related backgrounds straightforwardly lead to numerical violations of all of the classical point-wise energy conditions'. 1607.05280 p.17: 'a conformally coupled massless scalar field in the Unruh state has a stress-energy tensor that is Hawking-Ellis Type IV everywhere outside the horizon of a slowly evaporating Schwarzschild black hole'; for massless spin 1 'we are not certain that the stress-energy tensor for the electromagnetic field in the Unruh state is Type IV ... anywhere outside'. The tree's own summary of what the analogue measured (door.py:49-53): thermal spectrum, T set by surface gravity, Hawking-partner entanglement, inner-horizon stimulation.

H2 the effective metric governs only the linear perturbations; the medium's own energy density is that of an ordinary fluid (not stated as a hypothesis in the restatement; it is the construction of eq. B1)
H3 temperature fixed by surface gravity of the sonic horizon, T = hbar kappa/(2 pi k_B), conformally invariant; greybody factors are not (2106.03960 p.1)

H4 for the GRAVITATIONAL Hawking process, the NEC-violating <T_ab> is a TEST-FIELD computation on a fixed background (2102.13551 p.3: 'test field approximation; ie, picking a fixed background and ignoring back-reaction'); Type IV everywhere outside is shown for the conformal scalar only, uncertain for spin 1 (1607.05280 p.17)
H5 the NEC-violation inference uses the area-increase theorem, whose own hypotheses (NEC, plus the global-structure assumptions of that theorem) are what fail (2102.13551 p.5)
H6 (NAMED-NOT-READ) the primaries' own conditions -- stationarity, dispersion of the Bogoliubov spectrum, number of repetitions, the measured temperature -- could not be read this stage

rederivation.outcome: ALL PASS (exit 0), 9 checks. C1: for the acoustic metric W(x)^2[-(c^2-v^2)dt^2 - 2v dt dx + dx^2] (2106.03960 eq. B1, 1+1 part), the surface gravity of d/dt at the sonic horizon c=v is kappa^2 = (c'-v')^2, independent of W and W' -- i.e. the analogue Hawking temperature is set by the flow profile and is conformally invariant, agreeing with 2106.03960 p.1; guard: off-horizon the expression is not (c'-v')^2. C2: A = 16 pi G^2 M^2/c^4 gives dA/dt = 32 pi G^2 M dM/dt/c^4 < 0 under evaporation, so the area theorem's NEC hypothesis must fail -- re-derives the 2102.13551 p.5 sentence that ties Hawking radiation to NEC violation (the 'same family' link, gravitational case). C3: solving the infinitesimal boost+rotation invariance equations for a symmetric T_ab returns exactly lambda*eta_ab (one free parameter); a uniformly accelerated observer u = (cosh a tau, sinh a tau, 0, 0) then measures -lambda, the inertial value; with the flat vacuum renormalised to zero this is 0 -- the eternal Unruh effect carries no negative energy density in any frame. C4: T_H(M_sun) = 6.1703e-8 K, T_U(g) = 3.9766e-20 K, a(1 K) = 2.4661e20 m/s^2; T_H depends on GM only.

lacked_data: For this entry the relevant missing datum is not one the original theorists lacked and later acquired -- it is one nobody yet has. (1) No gravitational Hawking or Unruh flux has been measured: T_H(M_sun) = 6.17e-8 K and T_U(g) = 3.98e-20 K (computed, C4), so the 'analogue' qualifier is necessary, and the entry's own hypothesis already says so. (2) The analogue experiments acquired new data after Hawking 1974/Unruh 1976 -- thermality, T set by kappa, partner entanglement (restated 2106.03960 p.1; door.py:49-53) -- and that data CONFIRMS the kinematic prediction (C1 re-derives the conformal invariance of the analogue T). (3) The datum that would support the census use -- a measured negative (analogue) energy density or NEC violation in the medium -- is absent from everything read here and is recorded by the tree itself as UNPERFORMED (door.py:129-131). Evidence either way: having it would restore the census status word; its absence narrows the entry but cannot loosen the refusal, because removing a candidate source from a census of available negative energy only shrinks what the core could draw on. M's hypothesis (earlier physicists lacked data) is therefore not supported against the Hawking/Unruh theory -- the new analogue data agrees with it -- and the gap found is in the tree's labelling, not in the external result.
grade_evidence: The external result, as far as it could be read (via restatement, 2106.03960 p.1), is that analogue systems have produced observations of Hawking RADIATION; C1 re-derives the one closed-form piece (kappa^2 = (c'-v')^2 at the sonic horizon, conformally invariant) and agrees. achievable.py:34 uses it on a larger class: as a MEASURED member of 'THE CENSUS OF KNOWN NEGATIVE ENERGY DENSITY' (achievable.py:28-29). (a) The negative-energy side of the Hawking process is a computed test-field result for gravitational holes (2102.13551 p.5; 1607.05280 p.17; C2 re-derives the area-theorem link), field-dependent (Type IV certain for the conformal scalar, uncertain for spin 1), and not measured in any analogue -- the tree's own door.py:129-131 says 'UNPERFORMED'. (b) Under the reading 'Unruh effect', the Minkowski vacuum carries no negative energy density for any observer (C3, machine-checked), and no Unruh analogue measurement is cited or could be read (1807.07504 NAMED-NOT-READ) -- that half is OPEN, not WRONG; under the tree's other usage, 'Unruh state' (vacuumcorridor.py:27-28,61), the objection does not apply and the slash names one computed quantity. Not WRONG: no statement of the source is contradicted, and 'same family' is supported for the gravitational process. Not DATA-DEPENDENT: no moved datum enters (C4: T_H depends on GM only). Direction: the narrowing removes, it does not add, so it cannot weaken the SURVEY refusal (achievable.py:25-26) -- recorded, not in M's favour. Primary sources were unreadable this stage (alphaXiv quota; proxy 403), which is why read_status is READ-VIA-RESTATEMENT and the Unruh half stays OPEN.

Nothing here can move the refusal the census supports.
